amendments.because: On 2026-10-09 the owner explicitly chose the newer release for faster workflow after being told that it grants agents access outside the project without approval prompts. This accepts that host-access risk; it does not authorize bypassing tests, reviews, merge gates, or unrelated changes.
amendments.done_when: Forge runs v1.2.7 with existing financial-chat work preserved

done_when: Forge runs v1.2.7 with its owner-approved full-access agent settings, existing merge and review gates, and financial-chat work preserved

findings.body: The rule says, “Security and accessibility never simplified away.” This changes Codex from workspace isolation to unrestricted host access and pairs it with `approval_policy = "never"`; `.claude/settings.json:46-52` likewise blanket-allows Bash, file writes, and web access. A compromised dependency, repository instruction, or mistaken agent command can therefore read or alter files outside this checkout and make network requests without confirmation. Preserve `workspace-write` and approval boundaries, and grant only narrowly required host operations.
findings.title: Standard: Security and accessibility never simplified away
